integrity: The universal result is proved analytically from the exact BB secant formulas, a Rayleigh-quotient lower bound, and Stieltjes entrywise signs. Sharpness is proved by an explicit two-dimensional family; the exact-rational checker only replays finite algebraic identities and the stated witness.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies only the second post-warm-start iterate, assumes an exact-line warm start, and requires a symmetric positive definite Stieltjes Hessian. Later BB dynamics, inexact warm starts, nonsymmetric M-matrices, and general cones are not classified.
title: Condition two is the sharp second-iterate positivity frontier for the Barzilai–Borwein interval
